title: a11y callout -- input staging popover
desc: a11y type callout -- input staging approval popover before typing. Shows text-to-type in retro green bubble, tail points to caret/text-end in target element. User presses O to approve; typing fires from callout (PendingAction delegate).
steps: [POSITIONING] Body placed UPPER-LEFT of target element. PendingElementRect (element full BoundingRect) sets left boundary -- body right edge must be strictly left of element left (48px gap). Tail tip priority: 1) caret via TextPattern2.GetCaretRange reflection 2) text-end via DocumentRange.GetBoundingRectangles last rect right edge 3) element left+20px fallback. Stored in PendingTargetRect. CalcCalloutGeometry() uses elementLeft for bodyX, tipX/tipY for tail -- the two rects are fully separated.

[APPROVAL FLOW] A11yCommand sets PendingAction=lambda before Probe(). WaitForUserYield shows callout (30s, O required). OnConfirm: Close() immediately via Dispatcher + background Task: 200ms + SetForegroundWindowRaw + idle gate (500ms/30s max) + action(). ActionExecuted=true blocks legacy type path. ReadinessAdapters forces timeoutSeconds=30 when PendingAction set.

[KEY FIELDS] PendingContent=text in body, PendingTargetRect=tip rect (caret/text-end), PendingElementRect=element full rect for body placement, PendingAction=Func<bool> on O-press, ActionExecuted=volatile bool. InspectTargetA11yNode -> A11yNodeInfo(ElementRect, TipRect, DpiScale). Clear all after scope walk.

[AUTO-SCREENSHOT] On Loaded: TakeElementScreenshotAsync captures PendingElementRect+30px padding via GDI CopyFromScreen -> Desktop/wkappbot-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss.png. Logged as [CALLOUT:SS]. Fallback: full primary monitor.

[DISPLAY] TextBlock+ScrollViewer (not TextBox -- no editable-placeholder). Retro green: bg #041004, text #00FF41, border #00DD33. 380x240px. Confirm=green circle+countdown (bottom-right). Deny=red X. Halo rings at tail tip. Chime C5-E5-G5-C6 on Loaded.

[POSITIONING v2] Body anchored 150px upper-left of current mouse cursor: bodyX = mouseX - 150 - BodyW, bodyY = mouseY - 150 - BodyH (DIP coords). Existing monitor-edge clamping (monL/monR + Margin) handles screen boundaries. Replaces element-left-edge placement that caused body to drift far left on wide elements (VS Code editor, HTS MDI windows). Cross-monitor and anti-overlap logic preserved.
